decision: Present the named Mellassine locality once in the manual picker, owned by the existing suburb point. Preserve the separately coded sector and the suburb as separate raw geographic records.
basis: The official registry corroborates Mellassine sector116156 in Sijoumi1161.
The source inventory has exactly these two locality name peers. Both are within the same coded Sijoumi parent; the suburb point is in the distinct Ali Belhouane sector116152.
The sector-name search and a fresh coordinate lookup at the existing suburb point both select الملاسين on the public Maps card.
Both retained representatives independently select prayer reference405. This preserves prayer behavior but is not used as evidence of administrative identity.
limitations: This is a reviewed manual display inference, not a claim that the two source geometries represent the same administrative boundary.
The suburb point is outside the narrow namesake sector. No new neighborhood polygon or expanded sector polygon is created.
Maps outlines and coordinate readbacks do not certify a boundary.

workerReview.finding: The initial advisory correctly warned against geographic equivalence. This decision instead limits consolidation to the manual display choice and preserves all geographic scopes.
